name: Carphenazine
aliases: Carfenazine, carfenazina, carfénazine, carfenazinum, Proketazine®, WY-2445
summary: Carfenazine is an antipsychotic and tranquilizer of the phenothiazine group that was withdrawn from the market.

uses.text: Carfenazine (INN; former development code WY-2445; BAN carphenazine; USAN carphenazine maleate; brand name Proketazine; former development code NSC-71755) is an antipsychotic and tranquilizer of the phenothiazine group that was withdrawn from the market.

pharmacology.en: Like other phenothiazine antipsychotics, it is thought to work mainly by blocking dopamine D2 receptors in the brain.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他啡噻𠯤類抗精神病藥一樣，一般認為它主要透過阻斷大腦中的多巴胺 D2 受體發揮作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他啡噻𠯤类抗精神病药一样，一般认为它主要通过阻断大脑中的多巴胺 D2 受体发挥作用。

sideEffects.en: Little detailed information is available. Phenothiazine antipsychotics commonly cause drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth and movement problems such as stiffness, tremor and restlessness, and long-term use can cause tardive dyskinesia. Rarely they cause neuroleptic malignant syndrome, which is life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它的詳細資料很少。啡噻𠯤類抗精神病藥常造成嗜睡、頭暈、口乾，以及僵硬、顫抖、坐立不安等動作問題，長期使用可能造成遲發性運動障礙。少數情況下會引發危及生命的抗精神病藥惡性症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它的详细数据很少。啡噻𠯤类抗精神病药常造成嗜睡、头晕、口干，以及僵硬、颤抖、坐立不安等动作问题，长期使用可能造成迟发性运动障碍。少数情况下会引发危及生命的抗精神病药恶性症候群。

fact.en: Phenothiazine, the core of carphenazine, was first made in 1883 by the German chemist August Bernthsen, decades before its relatives became medicines. It was later used as an insecticide and as a worm treatment for farm animals.
fact.zh: 卡奮乃靜的核心結構啡噻𠯤，在 1883 年由德國化學家奧古斯特·伯恩特森首次合成，比它的衍生物成為藥物早了數十年。它後來還被用作殺蟲劑和家畜的驅蟲藥。
fact.zhHans: 卡奋乃静的内核结构啡噻𠯤，在 1883 年由德国化学家奥古斯特·伯恩特森首次合成，比它的衍生物成为药物早了数十年。它后来还被用作杀虫剂和家畜的驱虫药。
